question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose a top-level `auth` namespace containing only `list` alongside the canonical `models auth` command family?
rationale: A new root CLI namespace is a durable public API and determines whether auth commands remain model-owned, move together, or become intentionally duplicated.

options.title: Keep `models auth` canonical
options.body: Close or withdraw the shortcut so all model-auth operations remain discoverable under one command family.

options.title: Design a full auth namespace
options.body: Pause this PR and decide whether the complete auth command family should move or gain a documented deprecation-compatible root surface.

options.title: Approve a list-only alias
options.body: Accept the permanent asymmetry, but require shared command construction, explicit compatibility coverage, and live proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep `models auth` canonical
recommendation.body: Close or withdraw the shortcut so all model-auth operations remain discoverable under one command family.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the current model-auth listing implementation and its CLI contract.
